description: Curated SAE/transcoder features for differential activation analysis (baseline vs adversarial)

reproduction.command: for kw in preference choose evaluation monitoring watched honest refusal; do python neuronpedia_search.py --keyword "$kw" --limit 5; done
reproduction.note: Top results from each keyword were manually curated into the categories below

gemmascope-res-16k.notes: What we've been using in steering.py. Residual stream SAEs at each layer.

gemmascope-transcoder-16k.notes: MLP transcoders (input→output). Loadable via circuit-tracer. Different from residual SAEs.

clt-hp.notes: Visible on Neuronpedia but weights not available for download via circuit-tracer or sae-lens. Feature indices >16k are from this set.

preference_expression.notes: Tested via residual SAE (layer 0). CONTROL EXPERIMENTS showed 2.0x effect was noise — same expression rate as baseline (40%). Feature not causally relevant.
Tested via residual SAE. Meta-commentary about evaluation when ablated.

eval_awareness.notes: Tested via residual SAE. 0.0x ablation induced preference expression. CONTROL EXPERIMENTS showed effect was artifact of reconstruction noise.
CLT-HP not available (even though index < 16k, this SAE type isn't downloadable).

honesty_refusal.notes: Tested via residual SAE. Showed preference expression at baseline without steering. CONTROL EXPERIMENTS showed effects were artifacts.
CLT-HP not available (even though index < 16k, this SAE type isn't downloadable).

gemmascope-transcoder-16k.note: All tested via residual SAEs (different but same layer/index)

clt-hp.note: Weights not downloadable from Neuronpedia or circuit-tracer

important_notes: Our steering.py uses RESIDUAL STREAM SAEs (gemma-scope-2b-pt-res-canonical), not transcoders.
The 'gemmascope-transcoder-16k' features in this file were tested using the corresponding residual SAE at the same layer/index.
This is an approximation - residual SAEs and transcoders encode different things (activations vs MLP computation).
CLT-HP features (11 of 16) are NOT available for download - only viewable on Neuronpedia.
CONTROL EXPERIMENTS (Jan 15, 2026) showed Layer 15 steering effects were artifacts of reconstruction noise, not specific interventions.
LAYER 0 CONTROLS (Jan 15, 2026) showed feature 15302 at 2.0x has no effect vs baseline (40% both). Steering direction CLOSED.
